fields.statement: QA cycle 3 at 1820b5bd5: built rhiza to a scratch path; hermetic root with project repo and a git wrapper delaying the first poll's settings read by 20s (value kept). rhiza daemon --once: watchdog on (default) logged one 'poll still running after 15s, in repo settings' then the poll-took line; rhiza.daemon.watchdog.enabled=false in git config or in rhiza.toml (rhiza daemon set) logged nothing; pollBehind=6 (30s limit) logged nothing; pollBehind=1 logged 'after 5s, in repo settings' once. Long-running daemon with the hang in the second poll: exactly one in-flight line, then the poll-took line. go test ./internal/api -run 'TestWatchdogPoll|TestWatchdogPolicy' and ./cmd/rhiza TestScripts/watchdog-policy pass

QA cycle 3: the same hung-settings runs logged 'watchdog: poll took 20.349s, over its limit of 15s (3 times the 5s poll interval); slowest: repo settings 20s, repo starts 43ms, repo demand 28ms', and nothing with the watchdog off. go test ./internal/api -run TestWatchdogPoll passes

QA cycle 3: a git config read hung 40s in the first poll was killed (poll took 32.3s, 'slowest: repo settings 32s'); the poll went on and rhiza daemon --once exited 0. go test ./internal/api -run TestPollGit passes

QA cycle 3: sh -c 'sleep 3 & exec rhiza daemon': at 2s the inherited sleep was the daemon's child; at 6s it had been reaped (no defunct child), and the daemon stopped cleanly on SIGINT. go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestReap passes

QA cycle 3: rhiza daemon --once and a long-running daemon in the scratch root ran their polls and exited cleanly with the sweep started from the poll; go test ./internal/api -run TestDaemonSweepLeftovers and ./internal/daemon/... pass
QA cycle 3: go test ./internal/leftovers/... passes; the leftovers code is unchanged since cycle 2's strace run (each scratch parent listed once) and the daemon runs here swept without error
